authority.scope: This is the single public project task and role register. It records ownership, technical evidence, dependencies, and next decisions.
authority.limits: Task entries do not authorize publication, deployment, data sharing, package installation, security changes, human-participant research, or features outside the documented static scope. Those actions require appropriate explicit authorization.
authority.evidencePolicy: Keep passed, failed, blocked, and not-run work distinct. Never infer browser, device, clinical, or accessibility acceptance from synthetic checks.
authority.privacyPolicy: Use synthetic fixtures only. Do not add personal observations, credentials, private identifiers, or unreviewed process output.
authority.writePolicy: Each task may change only its declared public paths. A single writer must own a shared path at a time; coordinate a handoff before overlap. Generated local browser output remains untracked pending review.
authority.attemptPolicy: Historical attempt logs are not imported. Empty attempts arrays mean no public per-attempt entries are recorded, not that no earlier work occurred. Append only observed attempts with exact inputs, outputs, status, and evidence.
